styleSystem: A coordinated SportHub Court & Volt die-cut sticker set. Court lines, teal, deep teal, chalk, restrained volt and sport-specific orange.

Composition centered compact sticker mark, slight diagonal, transparent background. No words, no lettering, no logos, no watermark, no collage, no shadow detached from sticker.
